packs.description: 7 colour nodes: make, channel, lerp, brightness, gray, hex to color and color to hex.
10 time nodes: format duration, duration and date parts, to seconds, time of day, time ago, month and weekday names, now and make timestamp.
15 nodes for inventory menu replacements: key, equip, drop, item card and category events, select, drop, sound and 3D item actions.
37 math nodes: trigonometry, rounding, powers and logs, remap, wrap, easing, distance and random helpers.
35 array and object utilities: index of, get, slice, unique, sort, shuffle, sum, pluck, filter by field, keys, values, merge and more.
30 text utilities: trim, pad, truncate, search, split, format thousands, escape HTML and more.
